timeline.title: A beginning in service
timeline.text: Established in March as the Social Welfare Apostolate of the Catholic Diocese of Maiduguri.

timeline.title: Justice, development, peace
timeline.text: The Social Welfare Apostolate became the Justice Development and Peace Commission (JDPC).

timeline.title: Our registered identity
timeline.text: Justice Development and Peace Initiative became the name recognised by the Corporate Affairs Commission.

timeline.title: One identity. Same mission.
timeline.text: Our public identity was aligned with our registered name, JDPI Maiduguri, with continuity of purpose and partnerships.

values.title: Human dignity
values.text: Every person deserves respect, protection and the opportunity to thrive.

values.title: Justice
values.text: We stand for fair opportunities and the rights of people facing exclusion.

values.title: Peace
values.text: We nurture dialogue, reconciliation and peaceful coexistence.

values.title: Solidarity
values.text: We stand alongside vulnerable communities and listen to their voices.

values.title: Accountability
values.text: We use entrusted resources responsibly and learn from communities.

values.title: Service
values.text: Compassion and practical action are at the heart of our work.

approach.title: Community-led
approach.text: Local knowledge, participation and priorities inform how we design and deliver programmes.

approach.title: Integrated
approach.text: We respond to interconnected needs, linking immediate assistance with longer-term recovery.

approach.title: Inclusive
approach.text: Women, children, persons with disabilities and other vulnerable groups are considered in programme design.

approach.title: Sustainable
approach.text: We strengthen local skills, livelihoods and community structures that can outlast a project.

sectorImpact.title: Food Security & Livelihoods
sectorImpact.label: People reached
sectorImpact.description: Agricultural support, livelihoods and food assistance helped households meet immediate needs and build resilience.

sectorImpact.title: Nutrition
sectorImpact.label: Children and caregivers supported
sectorImpact.description: Lifesaving nutrition support included community-based care, referrals and nutrition education.

sectorImpact.title: Water, Sanitation & Hygiene
sectorImpact.label: People with improved safe-water access
sectorImpact.description: An estimated 22,000 people gained improved access to safe water. JDPI completed 22 boreholes: 15 constructed and 7 rehabilitated.

sectorImpact.title: Mental Health & Psychosocial Support
sectorImpact.label: People reached through messaging
sectorImpact.description: Mental health and psychosocial support messages expanded awareness. This figure is not a count of people receiving individual counselling.

sectorImpact.title: Protection
sectorImpact.label: People reached through awareness activities
sectorImpact.description: Awareness sessions and messages shared information on safety, dignity, rights and available support services.

sectorImpact.title: Social Cohesion & Peacebuilding
sectorImpact.label: Community conflicts resolved
sectorImpact.description: Community-led peacebuilding mechanisms helped resolve conflicts and strengthen peaceful coexistence.

activities.title: Nutrition and WaSH
activities.text: INTO-MAMI supported mothers, infants and community water services in Jere and Magumeri. The public closeout update confirms completion; it does not establish 2025-only LGA totals.
activities.source: JDPI INTO-MAMI project brief and public closeout update

activities.title: Community nutrition
activities.text: The report describes screening, referral, growth monitoring and caregiver nutrition counselling for a child in Magumeri through a CRS-supported programme.

activities.title: Nutrition and WaSH
activities.text: Magumeri was also a location of the completed INTO-MAMI project with CRS. Project details are recorded separately from the report’s 2025 results.
activities.source: JDPI INTO-MAMI project brief and public closeout update

activities.title: Mental health and psychosocial support
activities.text: In Tsallake, counselling and appropriate medical support helped a conflict-affected child recover under the GFFO-funded Food Security and Humanitarian Protection for Victims of Lake Chad project.

activities.title: Climate-smart agriculture
activities.text: Hong and Michika hosted community greenhouses. The report also describes irrigation equipment, seeds and farmer training in Kwatau, Hong.

activities.title: Safe water
activities.text: A motorised solar-powered borehole in Kilamada reduced reliance on river water and brought safer water collection closer to households.

activities.title: Climate-smart agriculture
activities.text: Community greenhouse farming in Hong and Michika supported year-round vegetable production under the BMZ-funded resilience project.

activities.title: Livelihood recovery and savings
activities.text: Reported experiences in Michika describe income-generating grants, restarting small businesses and savings-group participation.

activities.title: Vocational skills and livelihoods
activities.text: In Dar community, a participant received barbering training and a start-up kit through Strengthening Protection and GBV Response in Madagali.

activities.title: Integrated nutrition and protection
activities.text: JDPI’s supplied project brief also lists the NHF nutrition and protection project in Madagali. Whether it is the same award as the report-listed GBV project remains under review; the two are not combined here.
